Chapter 882: Chapter 19 Guaranteed Win (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 882: Chapter 19 Guaranteed Win (Please Subscribe)_2

Just like a firearm can overpower the lower feudal civilizations on the Barbaric Wilderness Planet, but if you lose the strength to pull the trigger, the firearm is naturally equivalent to garbage.

The essence of life is just like this.

Activating an ultimate treasure that far exceeds one’s own limits definitely places extremely strict demands on the essence of life.

Once the Galaxy Master’s life essence drastically declines, even if it’s not a drastic decline, but just a drop, it will be impossible to continue activating that ultimate essence smoothly.

When that time comes, won’t the chance arise for the strongest Level Eleven Perfect beings from all the major peak clans?

The reduction in life essence will affect all aspects, and the Galaxy Master’s own strength will also decline.

“Galaxy Master, oh Galaxy Master, to have forced our clan to use this crucial treasure, you are quite remarkable indeed,” Fan Gaomo thought to himself.

In the past history, the Yu Clan has used the Balance Scale several times, but it was always against Level Twelve Ultimates.

And from beginning to end, those alien Level Twelve Ultimates never understood the true capabilities of the Balance Scale.

Thinking of this, Fan Gaomo put away the Balance Scale and walked out of the treasury.

Next, he still had to discuss matters with other peak clan forces.

If the Yu Clan brought out the Balance Scale, those peak clan forces would definitely have to pay a price.

It cannot be that the Yu Clan alone bears the burden.

…

Massive battlefield.

Central location, Victory Altar.

Many evolvers from the Human Civilization Alliance are guarding this place, chatting casually.

“So relaxed.”

“Indeed, in the past on big battlefields, even if our Human Civilization occupied the Victory Altar, we had to expend a lot of energy and face counterattacks from other clans.”

“But now, it’s been two or three years, those peak clan forces, let alone counterattack, they don’t even dare to come close.”

“Hahaha, isn’t it because the Galaxy Master took action and killed all the Level Eleven strong ones from those peak clan forces? Even if they want to counterattack, they need a Level Eleven to do it.”

“Right, losing avatars and trying to recondense them isn’t an easy task. At least for the short term, we don’t have to worry about those peak clan forces counterattacking.”

“I think even if those Level Elevens manage to recondense avatars, they still wouldn’t dare to come here. With the invincible strength of the Galaxy Master, who would dare to try again?”

…..

Many Level Eleven strong ones from the Human Civilization Alliance find their guard duty very relaxing. At this time in the past, they used to face endless attacks and probes from alien races.

Even the powerful Robber Clan has faced several instances where they had to retreat from the Victory Altar due to pressure.

Now, however, the Level Eleven strong ones of the Human Civilization Alliance are really at ease; this super huge battleground is almost like a vacation.

“Will those peak clan forces feel it’s hopeless to resist the Galaxy Master and simply give up the dominance of this battlefield?”

“Very likely. The strength of the Galaxy Master is too strong, lucky for us that the Galaxy Master is an evolver from our Human Civilization. If it were a strong one from other peak clans, that would be too desperate.”

“I wonder when the Galaxy Master will make the push for the ultimate level?”

“Ah, the Galaxy Master is not even a thousand years old yet; when I was his age, I hadn’t even heard of small battlefields.”

Many Level Eleven strong ones from the Human Civilization Alliance sighed in sentiment.

…

Deep within the Victory Altar.

Lin Yuan is sitting cross-legged.

“Recently, the strong ones from the Human Civilization Alliance have slightly relaxed,” Lin Yuan thought, controlling every little detail of the altar.

“I’ll remind them right away,” Xuanyuan You respectfully stood by the side and immediately said.

“No matter what advantages have been gained, this is a battlefield and one must never relax at any time,” Lin Yuan said.

“Yes.”

Xuanyuan You spoke quietly.

In reality, however, he couldn’t help but think… isn’t it because the Galaxy Master has achieved such great and glorious results? Whoever faced the current situation would relax.

Those Level Eleven strong ones from the peak clan forces, in front of the Galaxy Master, fell like dust; who wouldn’t feel relaxed seeing this?

“I will go and remind them now.”

Xuanyuan You respectfully exited, leaving only Lin Yuan sitting cross-legged there.

“I wonder when, and with what reliance, will the peak clan forces’ counterattack come?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Xia Qin, a mighty figure, believes that the eleven peak clan forces will absolutely not stand by and watch the Human Civilization Alliance obtain the first dominant position on the battlefield.

This is not a matter of dominance, but rather the ownership of hundreds of mighty weapons.

The eleven peak clan forces cannot accept the sudden loss of dozens, even hundreds, of mighty weapons.

Lin Yuan also agrees with this conclusion, so he transferred all the mighty weapons and treasures to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm early, waiting for the strong from the eleven peak clan forces to counterattack.

…

Cosmic Starry Skies.

A certain Desolate Star Domain.

More than ten enormous wills descend here, including Fan Gaomo, Tianyu Meng, and other strongest Level Eleven Perfect entities from the major peak clan forces.

On the super-large battlefield, these strongest Level Eleven Perfect beings, utilizing the Clan Suppression Weapons, cautiously hide in a corner, fearing the arrival of the Galaxy Master.

Therefore, to communicate with each other, they can only choose the Cosmic Starry Skies, where there is no threat from the Galaxy Master.

“How are you all prepared?”

“How to deal with the Galaxy Master?”

Tianyu Meng speaks first, the situation on the super-large battlefield greatly irritates the ancestors of the Tianyu Clan, but there is little they can do.

“The Galaxy Master is not easy to deal with.”

“Even if we use our clan’s ultimate essence, we are not completely certain of overwhelming the opponent.”

“Right, and activating the ultimate essence also puts a great pressure on us; we can’t sustain it for long.”

One after another, the strongest Level Eleven Perfect beings quickly exchange information, all waiting for the others to reveal their hidden cards.

“Alright.”

Fan Gaomo does not want to continue the quibbling and directly says: “My clan is willing to bring out the treasured ‘Balance Scales’, which can significantly weaken the life essence of the Galaxy Master, making it impossible for him to continue activating that ultimate essence.”

As soon as these words are out.

The whole scene is shocked.

Regarding the treasured ‘Balance Scales’, most of them have never even heard of it, but being able to significantly weaken the life essence of the Galaxy Master? That ability is indeed terrifying.

“Balance Scales?”

The strongest Level Eleven Perfect of the Robber Clan slightly changes his expression.

He has heard from the mightiest in his clan about this treasure, supposedly incredible, containing the Balance Path originating from the Chaos Void.

“How much life essence can it weaken?” Tianyu Meng immediately asks.

“It depends on how many Level Eleven Perfect beings you can provide.” Fan Gaomo replies.

To weaken the life essence of the Galaxy Master, they first must contribute life essence of the same level.

Since the contributed life essence is permanently lost, they definitely cannot sustain using the life essence of a single Level Eleven Perfect being.

According to Fan Gaomo’s estimation, one Level Eleven Perfect being contributing one-tenth of his life essence won’t have a significant impact on himself.

For ten Level Eleven Perfect beings, contributing one-tenth of their life essence each, the pooled life essence equals the complete life essence of one Level Eleven Perfect being.

Fan Gaomo plans to gather one hundred Level Eleven Perfect beings from the other ten peak clan forces, so the contributed life essence would reach ten times the entirety of a Level Eleven Perfect’s life essence.

With that, even accounting for losses during the exchange, it would drop on the Galaxy Master as at least four to five times the life essence of a complete Level Eleven Perfect.

Even if the Galaxy Master is powerful and his life essence is robust, ultimately he is still at Level Eleven and a fundamentally weak human; after the exchange of four to five times a complete Level Eleven Perfect’s life essence, it’s not to say he completely loses resistance.

At the very least, his strength will drastically decrease, unable to activate that ultimate essence.

“How many Level Eleven Perfect beings?”

The strongest Level Eleven Perfect of the ten peak clan forces slightly change their expressions, somewhat hesitant.

Life essence is not a joke, especially that of Level Eleven Perfect.

Level Eleven Perfect beings are the hope for each peak clan force to reach the ultimate; who can afford the loss of one-tenth of their life essence easily?

“Fan Gaomo, are you sure this really can handle the Galaxy Master?”

Tianyu Meng ponders for a moment, then starts asking in a low voice.

If they can successfully resolve the Galaxy Master and retrieve the mighty weapons of various clans, such a loss could be bearable.

“Rest assured.”

“Absolutely manageable.”

Fan Gaomo speaks confidently.
